6 Inch My Darling.name: 6 Inch My Darling
6 Inch My Darling.summary: 6inch My Darling is a visual novel romance adventure originally released by KID for Sega Saturn with free for all rating, thus not including adult content. Half a year later, the game was released on PC platform by Airyu with added adult content and altered setting and story elements.

Mega Man X3.name: Mega Man X3
Mega Man X3.summary: The PlayStation/Sega Saturn port of Mega Man X3 adds a new soundtrack in CD-quality and cutscenes in FMV.
